name: Cha ca
summary: Cha ca is grilled fish finished at the table with herbs. The dish list says catfish, spring onion, and dill. Another Hanoi page says snakehead, turmeric, and dill.
origin: Hanoi. Vietnam Tourism includes the dish on the city’s list.
howToEat: At the table, with spring onion and dill.

The dish list says catfish, marinated and grilled, with spring onion and dill. A second Hanoi food page says snakehead, fried with turmeric and dill, and says the Đỗ family has cooked it on Chả Cá street since 1871. The Michelin city tour also prints turmeric, at Chả Cá Thăng Long, 6B Đường Thành.
where: Đường Thành. The Michelin city tour names Chả Cá Thăng Long at 6B Đường Thành. The hour is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Cha ca — Hanoi grilled fish with dill
seoDescription: Cha ca in Hanoi is marinated catfish, grilled, then finished at the table with spring onion and dill, on Duong Thanh.
